answer_1.quote: we collect public interview transcripts and the associated summaries/topics... to build a large-scale dialogue summarization dataset, MEDIASUM. ... we evaluate several benchmark summarization models on our dataset.

answer_2.quote: We use the ROUGE metrics and hyper-parameters are chosen based on the highest ROUGE-L score on the validation set. ... ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L F1 scores
